papers.title_en: Physical AI: A Survey of Models, Learning, Systems, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Bin Gao, Anuj Gautam, Aritra Bagchi, Yunkai Liang, Wentao Li, Ronghui Li, Zhi Zhou, Yancan Mao, Xiao Yan, Xin He, Qingyun Zou, Wenshuo Yue, Dan Chen, Zhanglu Yan, Fei Xu, Huize Li, Weijie Wang, Tao Ouyang, Tulika Mitra
papers.evidence: 综述物理AI智能体的感知推理与行动
papers.tldr: 物理AI要求智能体在部分可观测、动态不确定、具身约束和实时性条件下感知、推理、行动与学习，而现有基础模型与机器人学习进展多局限于单一模型性能提升。本文以物理交互闭环为主线，系统梳理任务表示与记忆、预测与动作生成模型、数据与学习方法、具身与控制、计算系统、评测及安全等环节。进一步分析各组件如何相互作用并共同决定系统能力与局限，指出泛化、资源高效学习与执行、可靠状态跟踪、安全、恢复与持续适应等根本挑战。论文主张从孤立模型性能转向可集成、鲁棒、高效、安全且能自主适应真实环境的完整系统。
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI aims to enable intelligent systems to perceive, reason, act, and learn through interaction with the physical world. Unlike purely digital intelligence, physical agents must operate under partial observability, uncertain dynamics, embodiment constraints, and real-time requirements, while their actions continuously reshape the environment and subsequent observations. Recent advances in foundation models and robot learning have expanded the capabilities of physical agents, yet achieving reliable autonomy requires more than improvements in individual models. This survey presents a comprehensive, system-level review of Physical AI, organized around the closed-loop process of physical interaction. We examine the foundations and recent developments in task representations and memory, predictive and action-generating models, data and learning methods, embodiment and control, computing systems, evaluation, and safety. Beyond reviewing individual advances, we investigate how these components interact and collectively shape the capabilities and limitations of Physical AI systems. Building on this integrated perspective, we identify fundamental challenges in generalization, resource-efficient learning and execution, reliable state tracking, safety, recovery, and continual adaptation. We argue that advancing Physical AI requires moving beyond isolated model performance toward integrated systems capable of robust, efficient, safe, and autonomous physical interaction under changing real-world conditions.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
papers.authors: Yuwei Sun, Siyu Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向长时程具身规划的记忆增强潜在世界模型
papers.tldr: 潜空间世界模型在具身规划中可扩展，但存在表征坍塌、计算开销大和长时程能力弱的问题。本文在JEPA式预测中加入内容可寻址记忆库，在共享潜空间内进行多时间尺度学习，并用自适应层归一化调制预测。作者设计槽位多样性与时间利用均衡两项损失，防止坍塌并提升记忆效率。在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher和OGBCube上，该方法以轻量架构取得领先性能，长时程规划优于传统潜空间世界模型。
papers.abstract_en: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

papers.title_en: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
papers.authors: Xin Li, Xiaohuan Gu, Yifan Wang, Shaobin Ling, Tianli Shi, Jingao Xu, Zhimeng Yin, Dapeng Wu, Yun Wang
papers.evidence: 在空间任务中失败后反思的类脑自进化具身智能体
papers.tldr: 具身空间任务需基于部分视觉证据进行多步决策，失败原因难辨，单纯积累交互经验可能固化无效策略。HiMeco受元认知监控与海马记忆巩固启发，通过海马-元认知反思诊断感知-探索-规划失败，并提炼可复用策略与参数化技能。它在ESI-Bench取得SOTA，并在不进化条件下将EmbSpatial-Bench准确率提升3.94个百分点。该工作为具身空间智能提供了基于反思的自进化框架。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.

papers.title_en: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.authors: Chonghan Qin, Dongming Wu, Kaituo Feng, Jiaxu Wang, Xinlei Yu, Peiwen Sun, Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Bingao Chen, Weitong Lian, Ryan Ji, Wenqi Ren, Xiaobin Hu, Dahua Lin, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.evidence: 对在真实环境中推理、规划并行动的智能体机器人的统一综述
papers.tldr: 基础模型推动机器人智能从底层动作预测转向对数据采集、训练、规划与执行的目标导向编排，但研究彼此割裂、缺乏统一框架。本文梳理从机器人策略到智能体系统的演进，涵盖VLA模型、世界模型与世界-动作模型，并界定智能体机器人的范围。作者按Model、Data、Environment、Harness四大功能域将现有工作归为十七类，剖析智能体如何塑造模型学习、整理数据、构建世界与评测任务并组织能力。最后提出开放挑战与未来方向。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

papers.title_en: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
papers.authors: Weilin Ruan, Bohan Zhou, Jinghao Li, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Peiran Dong, Yingjie Xu, Leyi Wu, Haojian Huang, Binghui Xie, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen, James Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向具身空间智能的统一数据生成、训练与评测框架
papers.tldr: 具身空间智能需要模型定位实体、推理关系并输出可执行知识，但监督信号分散在几何与语义输出中，联合训练易混淆各阶段知识。Anvil统一框架包含数据生成、训练与评测：Anvil-Gen以11种“定位—关系—动作”形式构建异构数据飞轮，Anvil-Ben提供场景对齐监督与分阶段评测，Anvil-MOPD用9B学生模型从专家教师蒸馏并做语义优先故障路由。在七个公开基准上平均超过Qwen3.5-9B和RynnBrain-8B达9.29与11.03个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.

papers.title_en: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
papers.authors: SenseNova, Joint Research Team, Zhongang Cai, Ziang Cao, Tailai Chen, Han Chong Chua, Linjun Dai, Hanming Deng, Hokin Deng, Haiwen Diao, Chenjing Ding, Weichen Fan, Xiao Fu, Zerui Gong, Chenyang Gu, Zexin He, Zhi Hou, Bo Li, Qinyue Li, Quanzhou Li, Xiaowan Li, Zhichao Liao, Dahua Lin, Zilong Lin, Bo Liu, Chunxiao Liu, Pengfei Liu, Tianqi Liu, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy, Lewei Lu, Jiapeng Luo, Yuexiao Ma, Liang Pan, Xingang Pan, Oscar Qian, Ziyi Shang, Yuyao Shao, Dawei Su, Dacheng Tao, Qingyi Tao, Quan Wang, Ruisi Wang, Xiaogang Wang, Ziyi Wang, Beichen Wen, Donghao Wu, Jiaxu Wu, Silei Wu, Xiaoming Wu, Zhonghua Wu, Hongcan Xiao, Weiye Xu, Atsushi Yamashita, Lei Yang, Zhe Yang, Baiqiao Yin, Wanqi Yin, Hanfei Zhao, Tianbo Zhong, Long Zhuo, Jing Zuo
papers.evidence: 机器人操作与导航中的具身智能大规模评测
papers.tldr: 针对具身智能是否需为每个任务和本体单独构建专用模型的疑问，本报告系统评测了 GPT-6-Astra 在机器人操作与导航上的能力边界。方法上，在 12 个覆盖桌面操作、人形、移动平台与灵巧手的基准上采用统一协议，允许上下文学习并增加执行步数，同时研究高层 System 2 推理器与低层 System 1 控制器的闭环协作。结果显示其性能空前，但在 8 种真实机器人配置上仍暴露演示采集昂贵、难以用更长执行时间换取成功率等差距。贡献在于提出下一代具身基准原型，并判定其已跨过具身能力门槛、尚未达到实用具身智能。
papers.abstract_en: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: VLA-Fabric: Learning Interaction for Composable Multi-Arm VLA Agents
papers.authors: Chenglong Zhang, Shuaijun Liu, Feiyang You, Shuyang Hao, Chengyu Wu, Ningxin Su
papers.evidence: 多臂视觉语言动作具身智能体协同感知与动作
papers.tldr: 多臂操作需要协调，但完整 VLA 策略在动作生成时如何显式交互仍不清楚。VLA-Fabric 为每条机械臂保留一个完整 VLA，并通过跨策略边界的可学习交互实现协调。作者系统分析交互位置、同伴信息聚合与学习方式，并在不同 VLA 架构中复现该原则。三/四臂仿真与实物实验中，Full interaction 在四项实物任务上较独立训练局部策略提升 16–40 个百分点，指向可扩展的网络化具身智能。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are rapidly expanding what individual robots can accomplish, yet many real-world manipulation settings require multiple arms to operate as a coordinated system. Existing approaches organize multi-arm coordination in different ways, including centralized joint policies, high-level task or role assignment, and locally executed policies that react to teammates. However, how complete action-producing VLAs should explicitly interact with one another during action generation remains largely unexplored. We introduce VLA-Fabric, which organizes one complete VLA per arm while preserving local perception and action ownership, and enables coordination through learned interaction across policy boundaries. We first systematically study where such interaction should occur, how peer information should be aggregated, and how the interaction should be learned, revealing complementary coordination functions spanning shared context, peer-specific latent information, and action-stage interaction. We then re-instantiate these functions in a structurally different VLA architecture, showing that the coordination principle is not tied to a particular tensor layout or backbone implementation. Finally, we compose teams of three and four arms and evaluate them in simulation and physical experiments. On all four physical tasks, Full interaction improves success over independently trained local policies by 16--40 percentage points. Together, these results suggest that explicit interaction among complete VLA policies offers a scalable path toward networked embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation
papers.authors: Xinyi Hong, Mingyang Ren
papers.evidence: 具身基础模型与机器人策略的统一概率形式化
papers.tldr: VLA模型与世界动作模型在架构、输出表示和学习目标上存在差异，缺乏统一描述框架。论文提出基于随机核的架构无关概率表述，用条件输出分布与动作实现核刻画具身基础模型，并连接预训练、后训练与策略部署。作者将框架实例化到OpenVLA和DreamZero，覆盖自回归动作token预测与联合视频-动作生成。该工作为统一分析与设计具身基础模型提供了通用理论语言。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) have emerged as promising approaches to robot learning and control. These models integrate multimodal perception and action generation, but differ in their architectures, output representations, and learning objectives. In this paper, we present a unified, architecture-agnostic probabilistic formulation for embodied foundation models based on stochastic kernels. Our formulation has two key components: (i) we characterize embodied foundation models through conditional output distributions and action-realization kernels, which together induce task-conditioned robot policies; and (ii) we connect pretraining and post-training to policy deployment, accommodating model-specific pretraining objectives and offline or online post-training strategies. We instantiate the formulation for OpenVLA and DreamZero, covering autoregressive action-token prediction and joint video-action generation.

papers.title_en: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Jiajun Cao, Kai Tang, Bohua Zhang, Zezhong Qian, Ying Li, Xiaozhu Ju, Xiaobao Wei, Jiaming Liu, Yang Ding, Sixiang Chen, Yiding Sun, Siyuan Qian, Tinghao Wang, Jixian Wu, Yichen Guo, Yi Zhang, Shilong Zou, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.evidence: 闭环视觉语言与世界-动作模型，统一语言推理、动作生成与世界建模以支持规划
papers.tldr: 长程操作需语言规划与执行评估，现有世界动作模型难以闭环统一。LAW以语义子任务进度连接混合专家视觉语言模型与世界动作模型，实现子任务规划、动作价值融合与异步状态评估，并用双流分层视觉记忆和子任务局部价值学习增强时序建模。在50项RoboTwin任务上平均成功率94.21%，替换主干后达95.56%；真实长程任务平均成功率65%。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

papers.title_en: AWAM: Active Trajectory-Conditioned View Imagination for Robust Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiawei Geng, Zhenyang Liu, Yuzheng Wu, Yanwei Fu
papers.evidence: 面向具身预测与规划的主动世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 开放环境中遮挡、杂乱和视角变化会削弱机器人对空间关系的感知。AWAM 先预测任务相关的虚拟相机运动，将轨迹条件化视图想象输入几何世界模型，形成可复用空间先验，并经记忆压缩与实时观测交叉注意力融合来扩散生成动作。在 LIBERO-Occ、LIBERO-Plus、RLBench-OG 遮挡任务和真机试验中分别达到 75.9%、62.4%、76.5% 和 94.4%。该工作以主动观察弥合结构化操作与开放环境之间的感知差距。
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in embodied intelligence has enabled increasingly capable robots to follow language instructions and manipulate diverse objects. However, strong results in structured environments do not automatically transfer to open-world conditions, where clutter, occlusion, and changing viewpoints can obscure the spatial relationships required for action. To address this perceptual gap, a virtual active-perception paradigm is introduced. AWAM, an Active World-Action Model actively plans where to observe and imagines what will be seen along the planned trajectory before acting. Task-related virtual camera motion is predicted and used as a structured query into a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior for manipulation, which is later compressed into a fixed memory and fused with live observations through cross-attention for diffusion-based action prediction. AWAM achieves competitive success rates with 75.9% on LIBERO-Occ, 62.4% on LIBERO-Plus, 76.5% on RLBench-OG Occlusion1, and 94.4% in real-robot trials. These results support improved robustness to the evaluated occlusions and distribution shifts, addressing part of the gap between structured manipulation and less controlled environments.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
papers.authors: X. Feng, J. Tang, Z. Lin, L. Chen, S. Shao, Q. Lu, K. Huang
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体的具身规划数据集与交互式世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能体多局限于单一场景与特定任务，难以泛化到开放世界。作者提出 EmbodiedWorld-200K 大规模数据集，含20万+样本与从轨迹到语义指令的多级标注，并设计以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理的交互式强化学习后训练方案。实验表明，数据集预训练显著提升开放世界具身规划能力，世界模型内RL后训练在分布外场景也带来明显增益。该工作为通用具身世界智能体研究提供了数据、基线、训练评估代码与可扩展范式。
papers.abstract_en: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

papers.title_en: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
papers.authors: Tianyu Xin, Wanqi Zhong, Bowen Hu, Zhangchi Guo, Lijie Wang, Yiming Wang, Haoran Liao, Heyang Yu, Xiaoyu Tian, Zhiding Yu, Yiming Li
papers.evidence: 世界动作模型解耦物理状态与语义外观以支持具身任务
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型常直接用预训练视频模型的潜在表征作为世界状态，导致外观语义与物理构型纠缠。PrismWAM将状态解耦为语义规划、物理推演与可执行动作三段式，仅凭初始RGB预测目标图像并在深度空间细化演化。在仿真和真实操作中无需具身动作预训练也表现强劲，甚至超过OpenWAM-α等大规模预训练模型。该工作推动世界动作模型从建模“世界看起来如何”转向“世界如何响应动作”。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.

papers.title_en: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiaming Liu, Xinghao Zhu, Yiming Zhang, Shanghang Zhang, Yinxi Wang, Yichu Yang, Zhuoyang Liu, Dantong Niu, Soha Pouya, Juekun Li, Yan Chang
papers.evidence: 基于物理动作词表的先推理后执行机器人操作模型
papers.tldr: 机器人多模态推理中，语言推理擅长任务语义却难表达细粒度物理动态，潜空间推理又缺少可复用结构。PhysWord以原子动作动词为共享语义锚点，将动作词隐藏状态与未来观测导出的潜目标对齐，构建时序化Physical Words空间并自回归预测。方法在UniVTAC达90.3%、LIBERO-Long达99.6%，真实双臂与灵巧手任务亦优。其贡献在于用结构化潜推理衔接语义与物理动态，提升长程操作与泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

papers.title_en: ACE-Brain-0.6: Scaling Spatial Grounding for Physical Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yinhe Wang, Tao Tao, Zexin He, Shuang Luo, Wei Mao, Yao Mu, Feng Pan, Hanming Deng, Lewei Lu, Zhi Hou, Xingang Pan, Dahua Lin, Dacheng Tao, Xiaogang Wang
papers.evidence: 扩展空间定位作为具身操作模型的感知基础
papers.tldr: 通用多模态模型在具身操作中依赖强空间感知，但如何规模化提升开放模型的空间定位仍待探索。作者构建统一数据管线，将机器人操作录制与多源视觉数据自动标注为可验证的定位监督，并微调Qwen3.5-9B得到ACE-Brain-0.6。该模型在7个公开定位基准中4项超过GPT-6 Astra，平均分75.41对73.68。结果表明，扩展多源可验证定位监督能增强9B开放模型的空间感知，为通用具身操作夯实感知基础。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, demonstrate broad capabilities in embodied manipulation. Our analysis indicates that this generality is accompanied by strong spatial perception, as Astra can determine where to interact with task-relevant entities amid visual distractors. Because spatial perception connects high-level reasoning to the physical scene, we investigate scaling visual grounding to strengthen the perceptual foundation of general embodied operation. We develop a unified data pipeline that combines robot manipulation recordings with complementary visual data from diverse sources. After automatically annotating the robot recordings, the pipeline converts the collected data into verifiable grounding supervision. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on approximately 1.5 million samples produced by this pipeline yields ACE-Brain-0.6. The model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on four of seven public grounding benchmarks, with an overall average score of 75.41 compared with Astra's 73.68. Under a fixed Qwen3.5-9B fine-tuning setup, aggregate grounding performance improves steadily as successive data releases expand the training collection to cover a broader range of grounding scenarios. These results show that scaling verifiable grounding supervision from diverse sources can strengthen the spatial perception of an open 9B model for general embodied operation.

papers.title_en: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
papers.authors: Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen, Tianfan Xue, Bin Zhao, Bingqi Jiang, Zihan Guo, Zicai Cui, Yang Li, Ming Zhou, Xinyuan Chen, Lihe Ding, Xiao Chen, Yujin Wang, Shi Guo, Junting Dong, Tao Lu, Xing Shen, Haoyu Guo, Yao Mu, Haiyong Yu, Haoxiang Ma, Fuxian Huang, Qiaojun Yu, Yunsong Zhou, Kailin Li, Zirui Wang, Yufei Xue, Weishuai Zeng, Tao Huang, Zhigang Wang, Junli Liu, Pengyuan Wu, Pingrui Zhang, Haotian Wang, Dongzhan Zhou, Jiafei Cao, Feng Yuan, Xinyi Ye, Quanli Xuan, Mulin Yu, Shangding Gu, Kaiwen Song, Dong Wang, Jiarui Li, Kehui Liu, Zhongjie Jia, Dongjiang Li, Jiacheng Bao, Haoran Yang, Zhaoqing Chen, Yiming Sun, Bowen Zhou
papers.evidence: 感知、建模并作用于物理世界的物理人工智能系统
papers.tldr: 物理AI发展迅速但定义、技术版图与核心挑战尚未共识。该专著提出统一框架，将物理AI界定为在真实约束下通过持续反馈感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统。它梳理多模态感知、世界模型、具身基础模型、运动控制与软硬件协同等方法，并区分数字AI、具身AI、信息物理系统与数字孪生。进一步讨论仿真到现实迁移、安全治理与长期部署，指向可泛化的Physical AGI。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

papers.title_en: Embodied Task Agents Can Perform Fine Manipulation through Tactile In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Yubang Wang, Zezheng Huai, Yifei Zhang, Jinhao Wu, Yitong Chen, Haozhe Zhang, Sixian Li, Jingjing Gong, Zhenyang Lin, Ziyang Chen, Xipeng Qiu
papers.evidence: 具身任务智能体借助触觉经验完成精细操作
papers.tldr: 具身任务智能体能否不训练专用模型、仅凭触觉经验完成精细操作仍待验证。Tactile-ETA将专家演示中的视觉与双侧触觉观测同当前感知一起用于上下文学习，不更新参数即可选择动作。四类仿真任务中，相同两个演示加入触觉后平均成功率由15.75%升至24.00%；真实机器人上视觉触觉对齐演示把成功率从0%提高到60%。这表明上下文触觉经验可用于精细操作，并为扩展更多感官输入提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Can embodied task agents use tactile experience to perform fine manipulation without task-specific model training? We investigate this capability through Tactile-ETA, a system that incorporates tactile experience into an embodied task agent through in-context learning. Successful expert demonstrations show how contact changes during manipulation. We pair each recorded robot movement with its camera views and bilateral tactile observations. We keep tactile observations at the start and end of each movement and add two neighboring time points when the tactile images change markedly in between. The agent combines these demonstrations with current vision, tactile observations, and proprioception to select actions through general-purpose robot tools, without updating model parameters. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, adding tactile observations to the same two expert demonstrations increases average success from 15.75% to 24.00%, with current sensing and execution interfaces held fixed. Further experiments show that performance depends on the sensory content and representation of demonstrations, while comparing agent models on Lift Bottle reveals substantial differences under the same system configuration. On the real-robot tasks, demonstrations with aligned visual and tactile observations increase the task success rate from 0% to 60%. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of using tactile experience in context for fine manipulation and suggest a path toward extending embodied task agents to additional sensory inputs.

papers.title_en: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.authors: Zebin Xing, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Yichen Zhang, Zichen Li, Shangqing Zhou, Yujie Zang, Yuchen Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Haoran Li, Qichao Zhang
papers.evidence: 动作条件视觉-触觉世界模型，作为机器人策略评估与学习的交互模拟器
papers.tldr: 机器人策略评估与后训练依赖昂贵物理交互，而仅视觉可信的世界模型可能误判接触动力学。PhysCanvas 将多视角RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态与动作统一到视觉空间，并用一致性后训练提升物理可信度。在四项真实操作任务中，世界模型与真实成功率的平均相关系数由0.602升至0.885，策略后训练把π0.5真实成功率从59.1%提高到70.8%。结果表明统一多模态建模和一致性后训练可用于机器人策略评估与学习。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

papers.title_en: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.authors: Rahul Sajnani, Diego Romeres, Mingyuan Zhang, Kai Gao, Carl Qi, Baichuan Huang, Srinath Sridhar, Dylan Randle, Lillian J. Ratliff, Jose Barreiros, Manikantan Nambi, Jeroen Vanbaar
papers.evidence: 统一的世界-动作-语言模型，在共享表示中支持具身预测与控制
papers.tldr: 针对具身控制中语言、视觉与动作割裂的问题，UniWALM 在单一混合Transformer骨干内统一视频、动作和语言表示，各模态既作条件也作监督，并由分模态扩散头同步去噪。模型在同一次生成中解码子任务、文本记忆与动作，将生成语言回灌下一步，形成无需外部规划器的语言记忆闭环。作者还提出FMC训练目标提升扰动动作恢复能力。在MolmoSpaces、RMBench和真实找物任务上，它优于同骨干基线，文本记忆将成功率从11.1%提至61.1%。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

papers.title_en: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
papers.authors: Yijun Shen, Diqi He, Jinbang Guo, Wanyue Zhang, Jiaming Mi, Huan Yang, Zhongyuan Wang, Zhiwei Yu, Kai Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向物理环境中自适应具身规划的因果交互接地
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型具备推理能力，却难以判断动作何时可执行及其世界影响，环境依赖的前置条件与效果缺失使具身规划难以适应。CausGround 将交互经验蒸馏为以动作为中心、可复用的因果知识，并用因子化世界状态表示对象属性与对象间关系。规划时，它把任务相关因果依赖锚定到当前观测，反向推理前置条件、正向推理动作效果，以选择动作并做多步规划。在 VirtualHome、RoboCasa 和 SWITCH 上，它无需参数更新即提升高层与闭环规划及交互推理，并支持真实机器人顺序操作。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.

papers.title_en: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.authors: Yicheng Xu, Zhikai Xu, Ziyuan Chen, Yuhang Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向物理环境中长时程具身智能体的机器人全栈框架
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能体多针对指定目标或符号化动作，难以在物理与社会约束下评估长程适应能力。TARSphere以物理模拟器、具身NPC与事件驱动状态机搭建基础设施，并用冻结多模态大模型经多级可执行技能、层次记忆与执行反馈决策。基于此构建30个室内场景、360个回合的基准，设置五类配对条件。评测8个MLLM发现通用模型可优于具身模型，但任务更新与人机协作仍难，且碰撞跌倒凸显执行安全需与成功率并重。
papers.abstract_en: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 多模态具身智能体感知规划与行动的统一框架
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体正从计算机使用走向机器人使用，物理约束使决策更难、错误更难逆转。论文提出能力中心框架PAPAV，将感知、效应预判、规划、执行与结果验证统一起来，用以比较MMEA、MMA与机器人系统。对64个基准的分析显示评估几乎集中于执行，预判与验证分别仅5和3个。该框架为设计可靠物理智能体并提供覆盖五项能力的统一度量基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

papers.title_en: Agentic World Action Models
papers.authors: Zhuoyang Liu, Dantong Niu, Botong Zhang, Boning Shao, Jing Wang, Ruijie Zheng, Yuvan Sharma, Runyu Lu, Jiaming Liu, Renrui Zhang, Roei Herzig, Yutong Bai, Ken Goldberg, Danfei Xu, Yuke Zhu, Guanzhi Wang, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Trevor Darrell
papers.evidence: 联合预测视频与动作的智能体世界动作模型以支撑具身规划
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型能预测视频与动作，却缺乏组合式技能复用；智能体机器人依赖代码规划，但缺少物理动态预测支撑。AW-0在统一混合Transformer中联合生成代码、未来视频和机器人动作，由代码专家输出参数化技能例程与控制逻辑，并借自动标注管线构建可复用技能库。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实双臂任务上，它优于VLA与WAM基线，并提升语言跟随、语义推理和鲁棒性，打通规划、预测与执行。
papers.abstract_en: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

papers.title_en: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
papers.authors: Zhixi Cai, Fucai Ke, Sukai Huang, Maria Garcia de la Banda, Peter J. Stuckey, Gholamreza Haffari, Hamid Rezatofighi
papers.evidence: 真实环境中具身智能体主动视觉推理与证据获取的基准
papers.tldr: 现有视觉推理基准多评估被动观察和最终答案，难以检验智能体是否真正获取了支撑证据。JRDB-AVR基于真实JRDB机器人数据构建，要求具身智能体按时间戳和视角请求有限观察，并同时评估答案与视觉证据。实验显示当前基线答案准确率与证据准确率存在明显差距，VLMs可能给出无证据支撑的正确答案。该基准推动证据感知的主动具身视觉推理评估。
papers.abstract_en: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

papers.title_en: SkillWeaver: Agentic Exploration over Neural Interaction Skills for Scalable Robot Data Generation
papers.authors: He Zhu, Lusen Zhao, Kwan Man Cheng, Su Li, Katerina Fragkiadaki
papers.evidence: 基于神经交互技能的机器人数据生成智能体探索
papers.tldr: 机器人示教数据采集成本高且难扩展，仿真虽可替代，但现有流程依赖开环控制或预设技能序列。SkillWeaver 提出以 VLM 智能体在神经交互技能（NIS）上做闭环探索：NIS 是强化学习得到的可复用参数化策略，智能体调用并参数化这些技能，配合验证器引导的树搜索自动发现长程任务解法。该方法自主生成 39.1K 条示教、覆盖 14.1K 场景，蒸馏为视觉运动策略后显著提升对新物体、布局、任务与环境的泛化，并支持零样本/少样本 sim-to-sim 与 sim-to-real 迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale demonstrations have driven unprecedented progress in robot learning, yet collecting robot data through teleoperation is expensive and difficult to scale to diverse environments and long-horizon tasks. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing data-generation pipelines often rely on open-loop controllers, scripted skill sequences, or task-specific programs. We introduce SkillWeaver, an agentic framework that autonomously generates robot experience by exploring over Neural Interaction Skills (NIS): reusable, parameterized, closed-loop policies that expose learned physical interaction capabilities to a reasoning agent. Given a task and a simulated environment, a VLM agent reasons about what to do next, invokes and parameterizes NIS to interact with the environment, observes their outcomes, and generates verification, reflection, and memory to guide subsequent exploration. We instantiate NIS as reinforcement-learned policies for closed-loop, contact-rich manipulation and organize exploration as verifier-guided tree search, enabling the agent to discover successful long-horizon behaviors without relying on predetermined execution pipelines. SkillWeaver scales autonomously to 39.1K demonstrations across 14.1K scenes, which we distill into visuomotor policies. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation, training on SkillWeaver-generated experience substantially improves generalization to novel objects, spatial configurations, tasks, and environments, and enables zero- and few-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer. Our results suggest agentic exploration over neural interaction skills as a scalable alternative for robot data generation.

papers.title_en: Factorized Scheduling Principle: Learning Interpretable and Transferable Policies via Structured Additive Functions
papers.authors: Hong Je-Gal, Hyun-Suk Lee
papers.evidence: 通过结构化加性函数学习可解释的优先级调度策略
papers.tldr: 调度问题常可归结为按候选状态打分并选最高优先级项，但现有策略难兼顾可解释与跨规模迁移。FSP将系统状态表示为条件分布，并把全局调度原则分解为带可辨识约束的单变量与成对加性组件，部署时仍保持优先级打分结构。方法以策略目标结合条件分布上的时序差分信号学习该原则。合成与真实任务表明其性能强、可解释，并能零样本泛化到不同系统规模。
papers.abstract_en: Scheduling problems arise from repeatedly selecting one item from a set of candidates based on their states. These problems often reduce to assigning priority scores and choosing the highest-ranked item. In this work, we propose a factorized scheduling principle (FSP) framework to learn interpretable and transferable scheduling rules. The FSP framework represents system states as condition distributions and decomposes a global scheduling principle into additive univariate and pairwise components with identifiability constraints. The scheduling principle enables the framework to maintain a simple priority-based structure during deployment. This principle is learned by using a policy-based objective combined with a temporal-difference signal defined on the condition distribution. Experiments on synthetic and realistic scheduling tasks demonstrate the FSP framework's strong performance, interpretability, and zero-shot generalization across different system scales.

papers.title_en: Multidimensional Resource Scheduling with Small Demands
papers.authors: Yossi Azar, Rathish Das, Hao Sun
papers.evidence: 小需求下的多维资源调度
papers.tldr: 研究任意维资源需求与异质处理时间下的多维资源调度，需在每时刻各维总需求不超过1的约束下最小化完工时间。聚焦所有资源需求均很小的情形，证明向量装箱中的小向量现象可延伸至存在多时间尺度交互的时间调度。对最大处理时间归一化后，在每坐标足够小（O(ε²/log(d/ε))）时给出期望完工时间至多(1+6ε)OPT+3的随机离线算法。并进一步实现在线随机及确定性O(1)竞争算法，竞争比独立于维度和处理时间比。
papers.abstract_en: We study multidimensional resource scheduling. Each job $i$ has a $d$-dimensional resource-demand vector $v_i$ and a processing time $s_i$. The scheduler assigns a start time to each job, subject to the constraint that, at every time, the total demand of the jobs being processed does not exceed $1$ in any resource dimension. The objective is to minimize the makespan.   We focus on the regime in which every individual resource demand is small. We ask whether the favorable \emph{small-vector phenomenon} known for multidimensional vector packing, which corresponds to the special case of unit processing times, extends to jobs with heterogeneous processing times. The key difficulty is that arbitrary processing times create temporal interactions across multiple duration scales: a long job may overlap many shorter jobs, while feasibility must be maintained throughout every job's execution interval.   We prove that the small-vector phenomenon persists in this temporal setting. For any $0<ε<1/4$, after normalizing the maximum processing time to $1$, if every coordinate of every demand vector is at most $O(ε^2/\log(d/ε))$, we give a randomized offline algorithm that produces a schedule with expected makespan at most $ (1+6ε)\mathrm{OPT}+3$. Thus, sufficiently small resource demands admit asymptotically near-optimal schedules in arbitrary dimension, despite heterogeneous processing times.   We also obtain constant competitive ratios in the online setting. Let $T$ denote the ratio between the maximum and minimum processing times. If every coordinate is at most $O(1/(\log d\log T))$, we give a randomized $O(1)$-competitive algorithm, with a competitive ratio independent of both $d$ and $T$. We further derandomize our approach, obtaining a deterministic $O(1)$-competitive algorithm under a comparable smallness assumption.

papers.title_en: Context Matters! Social, Spatial, and Semantic Coordination with an Embodied Agent in Immersive Analytics
papers.authors: Andrew Cunningham, Nicolas Barbotin, Adam Drogemuller, Jack Faser
papers.evidence: 具身智能体感知并响应空间、社交与语义情境
papers.tldr: AR沉浸式分析中的具身智能体有望通过空间、对话与视觉交互支持自然协作，但设计需充分理解情境。论文提出初步概念框架，从空间、社会、语义三个维度组织情境，并区分嵌入性与感知性。作者以设计探针Cobot探索凝视线索、空间音频和任务感知行为等情境敏感交互。该工作为未来情境感知具身智能体设计提供了反思与启示。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI agents in Augmented Reality (AR) could enable more natural collaboration in immersive analytics by engaging users through spatial, conversational, and visual interaction. However, designing such agents requires careful attention to context. We propose a preliminary conceptual framework for context-aware design of embodied agents structured around three dimensions of spatial, social, and semantic. This framework is further categorised into embeddedness (how agents are situated in the contexts) and awareness (how agents perceive and respond to the contexts). To explore this, we present Cobot, an embodied AI agent designed as a design probe. Cobot supports context-sensitive interaction through features such as gaze cues, spatial sound, and task-aware behaviour. We reflect on its design and identify implications for future contextaware embodied agents.

papers.title_en: Low-Bit Distributed Constrained Optimization with Application to Optimal Scheduling and Allocation
papers.authors: Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian, Sergio Pequito
papers.evidence: 面向最优调度与资源分配的分布式约束优化
papers.tldr: 分布式约束优化中多比特梯度交换通信开销大。论文提出每有向链路每迭代仅传本地成本梯度符号的单比特算法，基于Laplacian梯度动力学并逐次保持等式需求约束。固定步长下用Lyapunov分析证明O(1/ε²)进入优化器邻域，误差为O(τ)与O(τ²)，且步长上界为时不变网络常数；box约束经平滑惩罚松弛并量化惩罚权重与间隙。进一步在B-连通权重平衡有向图上刻画不变集并推广至奇保号非线性；仿真显示通信成本降5-60倍。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a distributed resource allocation algorithm in which each agent communicates only the sign of its local cost gradient, a single bit per directed link per iteration. The algorithm is based on Laplacian-gradient dynamics and preserves the equality (demand) constraint at every iterate, guaranteeing anytime feasibility irrespective of termination time.   First, we provide a complete Lyapunov-based convergence analysis for the fixed-step-size regime: the iterates are shown to enter, in at most O(1/\varepsilon^2) iterations, a neighborhood of the optimizer whose radius scales as O(τ) in the decision variable and O(τ^2) in the cost residual, where $τ$ is the step-size. Crucially, the step-size bound is a time-invariant network constant (depending only on the graph Laplacian spectrum and the cost curvature bounds), so no adaptive tuning is required.   Second, we characterize the invariant set under B-connected, weight-balanced digraphs, strictly weaker than the all-time connectivity and doubly-stochastic weights assumed in most prior work, and show that any odd, sign-preserving nonlinearity yields the same invariant-set and descent structure, with the single-bit protocol being the extreme communication-minimizing instance of a broader nonlinear class.   Third, we address local box constraints via smooth penalty relaxation and quantify explicitly how the penalty weight interacts with the step-size bound and the optimality gap.   Simulations on economic dispatch (1000 generators) and CPU scheduling (500 servers) demonstrate that the single-bit protocol achieves 5-60 times reduction in total communication cost relative to multi-bit baselines, at the price of a tunable and explicitly bounded optimality gap. A diminishing step-size schedule is shown empirically to eliminate this gap; its formal convergence analysis is identified as an open problem.

papers.title_en: CARVS: A Congestion-Aware Algorithm for Online Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery in Human-Collaborative Warehouses
papers.authors: Chaoran Li, Zeyuan Zhao, Shao Zhang
papers.evidence: 机器人仓库系统中的在线多智能体取送调度
papers.tldr: 智能仓库中的人机协作带来动态障碍与实时响应难题，传统MAPD难以应对。论文形式化MAPDwHC问题，并提出CARVS算法，融合任务交换、校验检查与随机初始化以优化任务分配和路径规划。仿真显示CARVS在大规模场景显著减少路径规划超时，而传统MAPD算法失效。该工作提升了人机协作仓库的拥堵适应性与可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent warehouse systems have transformed logistics by integrating robots with minimal infrastructure changes, boosting efficiency and optimizing workflows compared to traditional human-only operations. However, human-robot collaboration introduces new challenges, particularly due to human uncertainty, which leads to dynamic interactions and unpredictable behavior. To address these complexities, this paper presents the Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery with Human Collaboration (MAPDwHC) problem, an extension of the Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery (MAPD) problem that incorporates human unpredictability. This problem adds key constraints, such as dynamic obstacles caused by robots temporarily blocking paths when interacting with humans, and the need for real-time responsiveness. We formalize the MAPDwHC problem with additional constraints and properties. Based on this problem setting, we propose the CARVS algorithm, which improves task assignment and path planning by integrating task swapping, validation checks, and random initialization. CARVS reduces congestion, enhances adaptability to human-robot interactions, and ensures real-time responsiveness. Simulation results show that CARVS significantly reduces timeouts of path planning in large-scale scenarios where traditional MAPD algorithms fail, improving both efficiency and scalability.

papers.title_en: Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for Deterministic Service Provisioning in the IoT-Edge-Cloud Continuum
papers.authors: K. Aghababaiyan, B. Coll-Perales, J. Gozalvez
papers.evidence: 跨连续体的任务卸载与计算资源联合分配
papers.tldr: 面向IoT-边缘-云连续体，任务需在异构资源间动态卸载以保障确定性服务。现有方法多最小化单任务时延或能耗，难以兼顾按时完成率。该文提出确定性任务卸载与资源分配方案，联合管理通信和计算资源，利用任务时延需求差异分散负载，并在资源紧张时优先高优先级任务。数值评估表明该策略扩展性更好，能通过均衡资源利用提升按时完成任务数。
papers.abstract_en: Future networks will seamlessly integrate computing and communication resources within a unified ecosystem of IoT devices, edge nodes, and cloud servers, forming an IoT-edge-cloud continuum. Within such an ecosystem, tasks can be dynamically offloaded to leverage resources across the continuum and efficiently scale with demand. Task offloading has traditionally focused on minimizing task execution latency or energy consumption. In contrast, we propose a deterministic task offloading and resource allocation scheme for the joint management of communication and computing resources to support services with deterministic service-level requirements. The proposed scheme aims to maximize the number of tasks completed on time, rather than minimizing the latency of individual tasks. To do so, it exploits variable task latency requirements to distribute the workload across the continuum. It can also prioritize high-priority tasks under resource scarcity. Numerical evaluations demonstrate that a deterministic task offloading strategy scales more effectively and can better guarantee timely task completion by balancing resource utilization across the continuum.

papers.title_en: Model What Matters: Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling for Language Agents
papers.authors: Maolin Ran, Minda Chen, Di Huang, Wei Xiong, Fei Huang, Weiwen Liu
papers.evidence: 支撑智能体决策的世界建模
papers.tldr: 语言智能体强化学习常依赖稀疏轨迹奖励，难以直接监督动作引发的环境变化，且现有世界建模多均匀处理全部观测。DGS-WM以决策引导筛选对后续策略响应有价值的观测单元，并按预测置信度自适应加权，构成辅助世界建模损失与RL联合优化。在单跳/多跳问答和交互网页任务上，不同模型规模与RL算法均取得一致提升，且优于全观测世界建模。该工作让世界建模聚焦决策相关信息，为语言智能体提供更稳定有效的辅助监督。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning provides a direct mechanism for optimizing task objectives in large language model-driven agents, but task rewards are typically sparse trajectory-level signals that only evaluate task success, without directly supervising action-conditioned environment transitions, leaving the model with limited explicit understanding of action consequences and environment dynamics. Recent work introduces auxiliary supervision through policy and world modeling co-training, yet typically treats complete environmental observations uniformly as world modeling targets, overlooking the varying decision relevance of observation content. We propose DGS-WM (Decision-Guided Selective World Modeling), a decision-guided policy-world modeling co-training approach for language agents. DGS-WM employs a Decision-Guided Observation Selection component that filters observation units with decision value as world modeling targets based on their support for subsequent policy responses, and a Confidence-Adaptive Weighting component that adaptively adjusts supervision strength according to the model's prediction confidence on selected targets. Together, these components form a decision-aware auxiliary world modeling loss, jointly optimized with the RL loss on the same policy model. Across multiple benchmarks covering single-hop/multi-hop question answering and interactive web tasks, DGS-WM achieves consistent improvements under different model scales and RL algorithms, demonstrating more stable and effective performance compared to full-observation world modeling methods.

papers.title_en: Dynamic Auction Mechanisms in a Closed-Credit Economy: Sequential Slot Reallocation in Air Traffic Management
papers.authors: Jihun Kim, Pan-Yang Su, Maria G. Mendoza, Victoria Marie Tuck, Chinmay Maheshwari, S. Shankar Sastry
papers.evidence: 基于封闭信用升价拍卖的不可分时隙序贯资源再分配
papers.tldr: 针对容量缩减导致预先分配的不可分割资源不可行、货币补偿又不适用的问题，本文提出闭环信用经济下的序贯资源再分配机制。以可循环人工信用结算分数禀赋，用预测值函数刻画跨期偏好，并设计分组升价拍卖以最小组清算价作为共同成交价。理论证明非短视个体理性、弱非交易者中立及统一市场最优需求清算下的帕累托效率，并给出误报收益上界；机场时隙仿真显示相较地面延误基线可降低总延误与取消成本。
papers.abstract_en: Indivisible resources allocated in advance may need to be reallocated when capacity reductions make existing assignments infeasible, yet monetary compensation is often impractical or undesirable. We develop a sequential resource reallocation scheme using reusable artificial credits, where agents hold pre-existing resource rights and have heterogeneous marginal valuations over time blocks. Capacity reductions produce fractional endowments, which our closed-credit scheme resolves into indivisible final allocations. We model agents' intertemporal preferences through a predicted-value-to-go function and characterize conditions ensuring that their optimal demand is non-increasing in price. We propose an ascending-auction mechanism that partitions agents into subgroups and uses the minimum subgroup market-clearing price as a common transaction price. We show that the mechanism preserves non-myopic individual rationality and weak nontrader neutrality. Moreover, we establish Pareto efficiency under optimal-demand clearing in the unified market and bound the expected gain from misreporting by the probability that an agent changes the common price. Simulations of airport slot reallocation demonstrate reductions in total modeled delay and cancellation costs relative to a ground-delay baseline.

papers.title_en: Converter-Aware Coordination of Computing Flexibility in Behind-the-Meter Data Centers
papers.authors: Ruolan Cui, Ruizhang Yang, Chenxi Hu, Franxis Yunhe Hou
papers.evidence: 数据中心工作负载调度与功率约束
papers.tldr: 数据中心可经工作负载调度重塑用电，但计算灵活性未必能转化为可实现的电力灵活性，忽略变流器与网络限制会引发过载和跳闸。本文提出变流器感知的日内调度，结合任务级混合整数建模、Minkowski和聚合、Shapley-Folkman凸化与四节点电气二阶锥模型。算例表明电气限制会重塑调度和新能源利用，固定训练难以在电压约束内满足全部推理，协同调度则推理缺口可忽略并通过交流校验。该工作凸显计算—电气协同对释放负载灵活性的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Data centers are emerging as large electricity consumers whose demand can be reshaped through workload scheduling. However, computing flexibility in behind-the-meter facilities does not automatically translate into electrically realizable power flexibility. Ignoring converter and network operating limits may cause converter overloads, protection trips, and interruptions to power supply and computing services. This paper proposes a converter-aware intraday scheduling methodology. First, a task-level mixed-integer linear formulation preserves synchronous training configurations and completion requirements, while Minkowski-sum aggregation and Shapley--Folkman convexification yield a linear inference-pool representation without unit-level binary variables. The latter admits a conditional relative relaxation-gap bound that decreases inversely with pool size. Second, a four-node electrical model links computing demand, on-site injections, and grid exchange to converter and network limits through lifted voltage variables and second-order cone relaxation. Finally, a mixed-integer model coordinates workloads, photovoltaic generation, energy storage, and grid purchases. Case studies show that electrical limits reshape scheduling and renewable utilization, while on-site resources reduce grid dependence. Under the studied conditions, fixed training cannot support full inference service within voltage limits, whereas coordinated scheduling achieves negligible inference shortage and passes verification against the original alternating-current model. These findings demonstrate the role of computing--electrical coordination in realizing the operational value of workload flexibility.

papers.title_en: Exploiting the Flexibility of LLM Inference for Frequency Regulation Service
papers.authors: Yimeng Sun, Zhaohao Ding
papers.evidence: 计算集群中的推理请求调度与token级资源分配
papers.tldr: LLM 推理集群用电增长，但其执行特性可把推理请求调度变成可控负荷。论文将请求到副本分发与 token 级资源分配建模为分层马尔可夫决策过程，并用奖励重分配网络对齐毫秒级调度与秒级调频信号，再用平均场近似协调大量副本。基于真实数据的仿真表明，该方法能准确跟踪调频信号且不牺牲服务等级目标。这为 LLM 集群参与电网频率调节提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: While the widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly driven up power demands in computing clusters, the unique execution characteristics of LLM inference offer a novel opportunity to utilize these clusters as controllable loads. In this paper, we investigate the potential of LLM inference cluster to provide frequency regulation services through inference request scheduling. First, we model the problem as a hierarchical Markov decision process that includes request-to-replica dispatching and token-level resource allocation. Then, we introduce a reward redistribution network to address the temporal asynchrony between millisecond-level scheduling decisions and second-level frequency regulation signals. Furthermore, we develop an optimization framework based on a mean-field approximation to enable coordination among a large number of replicas under high request concurrency. Simulations using real-world data demonstrate that the proposed approach accurately tracks frequency regulation signals without compromising service-level objectives.
